label: Examine the dome and gantry
description: Walk the scene: body position, the gantry stairs, the upper rail.
narration: The scene is photographed and the upper gantry rail is dusted for prints.

label: Recover the victim's personal effects
description: Search Voss's clothing and seize anything he was carrying.
narration: A cracked mobile phone is recovered from the victim's jacket and bagged.

label: Order the post-mortem
description: Have the pathologist examine the body and report.
narration: The pathologist's report arrives at the laboratory.

label: Pull the keycard access log
description: Export Saturday night's door records from the access-control server.
narration: The door controller's records for the night are exported and hashed.

label: Seize the CCTV recordings
description: Image the security DVR and review the lobby and corridor cameras.
narration: The DVR is imaged. One camera has a hole in its night.

label: Seize the security logbook
description: Take the night guard's handwritten log from the security desk.
narration: The logbook is taken from the security desk and its pages numbered.

label: Obtain the gala photographer's pictures
description: Ask the event photographer for the full time-stamped set.
narration: The photographer hands over three hundred time-stamped frames.

label: Audit the security admin console
description: Find out who switched the dome corridor camera off, and from where.
narration: The admin console gives up its audit trail.

label: Requisition the grant ledger
description: Obtain the research-grant accounts from the bursar.
narration: The bursar produces three years of grant accounts.

label: Search the archive room
description: Search the archive room — a shared workspace — including its waste bins.
narration: At the bottom of the archive-room bin, under shredded paper, there is something burgundy.

label: Take the USB drive Theo offers
description: Theo has admitted what he was doing; accept the drive he volunteers and image it.
narration: Theo Lark hands over a USB drive, looking as if it weighs ten kilos.

label: Search Theo Lark's locker
description: Search Lark's personal locker in the control-room annexe. This is a private space.
narration: Lark's locker is opened. Behind a bike helmet there is a USB drive.

label: Trace Ashby's departure
description: Obtain the valet records and motorway toll data for Ashby's car.
narration: The valet company and the toll operator answer the production request.

label: Search Mara Quill's private office
description: Search the deputy director's locked office and desk. This is a private space.
narration: The locked desk drawer in the deputy director's office is opened.
